description_zh: ego 车辆从 Treat Avenue 右转进入 Alameda Street 西行时，转弯过宽，撞击了对向车道停止线处等候左转的静止车辆（v1），测试右转路径规划与侵占判断。

source_snippets: a passenger car (Vehicle 2), making a wide right turn from Treat Avenue onto westbound Alameda Street, collided head-on with the front of the stopped Zoox vehicle
Vehicle 1 ... was stopped in lane at a stop sign on eastbound Alameda, preparing to turn left onto Treat Avenue
evidence.reason: 选取移动且执行转弯的车辆2为ego；静止的车辆1作为NPC，位于路口对向停止线（opposing_leg），使用static_hold表示静止；环境依照报告选clear/night。
